question: closest river to each african country centre km
sql: WITH cen AS (SELECT name, ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS g FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Africa'), riv AS (SELECT name AS river, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS g FROM rivers WHERE feature_class = 'River' AND name IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL) SELECT c.name AS country, n.river, round(n.d / 1000, 1) AS km FROM cen c, LATERAL (SELECT r.river, ST_Distance(c.g, r.g) AS d FROM riv r ORDER BY d LIMIT 1) n ORDER BY km LIMIT 20

question: rivers within 500 km of germany centre
sql: WITH de AS (SELECT ST_Transform(ST_Centroid(geometry), 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3035', always_xy := true) AS g FROM countries WHERE name = 'Germany') SELECT r.name AS river, r.feature_class, round(ST_Distance(de.g, ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3035', always_xy := true)) / 1000) AS km FROM rivers r, de WHERE r.name IS NOT NULL AND ST_DWithin(de.g, ST_Transform(r.geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3035', always_xy := true), 500000) ORDER BY km LIMIT 10

question: isolated european countries nothing within 100 km
sql: WITH eu AS (SELECT name, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3035', always_xy := true) AS g FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Europe') SELECT a.name AS country FROM eu a, LATERAL (SELECT count(*) AS n FROM eu b WHERE b.name <> a.name AND ST_DWithin(a.g, b.g, 100000)) x WHERE x.n = 0 ORDER BY a.name

question: nearest river to every lake centreline
sql: WITH lakes AS (SELECT name, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS g FROM rivers WHERE feature_class = 'Lake Centerline' AND name IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL), flow AS (SELECT name, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS g FROM rivers WHERE feature_class = 'River' AND name IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL) SELECT l.name AS lake, n.name AS nearest_river, round(n.d / 1000, 2) AS km FROM lakes l, LATERAL (SELECT f.name, ST_Distance(l.g, f.g) AS d FROM flow f ORDER BY d LIMIT 1) n ORDER BY km LIMIT 15

question: nearest neighbour country by great circle oceania
sql: WITH c AS (SELECT name, ST_Centroid(geometry) AS p FROM countries WHERE continent = 'Oceania') SELECT a.name AS country, n.other, round(n.d / 1000) AS km FROM c a, LATERAL (SELECT b.name AS other, ST_Distance_Sphere(a.p, b.p) AS d FROM c b WHERE b.name <> a.name ORDER BY d LIMIT 1) n ORDER BY km DESC

question: two nearest countries to each top rank river
sql: WITH big AS (SELECT name, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS g FROM rivers WHERE scalerank <= 2 AND name IS NOT NULL AND geometry IS NOT NULL), ctry AS (SELECT name AS country, ST_Transform(geometry, 'EPSG:4326', 'EPSG:3857', always_xy := true) AS g FROM countries) SELECT b.name AS river, n.country, round(n.d / 1000, 1) AS km FROM big b, LATERAL (SELECT c.country, ST_Distance(b.g, c.g) AS d FROM ctry c ORDER BY d LIMIT 2) n ORDER BY river, km
